svg.title: AI Design Blueprint — Model Strategy, Knowledge & Retrieval, MCP & Connector
svg.desc: Three design cards. Define model strategy based on actual task requirements across three dimensions: single or hybrid models, large or small models, and text-only or multimodal models. Build knowledge bases by extracting, cleaning, chunking and indexing; embeddings feed the vector index while chunk text feeds the keyword index. Retrieve with vector and keyword search, merge and deduplicate, rerank, and return cited evidence. Define reliable, secure and traceable tool access. Transparent canvas, 2:1 aspect ratio.

g.text: Use one model, or route and combine
